test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

________ in biotechnology and medicine have resulted in higher expectancy rate and lower mortality rate.
solution: The correct answer is: **Advancements**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Advancements**" means progress or improvements in a particular field. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में प्रगति या सुधार) • **Example**: *Recent advancements in technology have revolutionized the way we communicate.* • The sentence talks about progress in biotechnology and medicine resulting in higher life expectancy and lower mortality rate. • "Advancements" is a noun and fits in the blank appropriately. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. **Complete sentence**: *Advancements __in biotechnology and medicine have resulted in higher expectancy rate and lower mortality rate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Arrogate**: To take or claim something without justification. (बिना किसी औचित्य के कुछ लेना या दावा करना) • **Aversions**: Strong dislike or opposition towards something. (किसी बात के प्रति तीव्र नापसंदगी या विरोध) • **Saturation**: State of being completely filled or soaked. (पूरी तरह भर जाने या भीगने की अवस्था या भाव) 1b9:T7d2, The correct answer is: "**Far, far at the top of them**,"
